Use Astra to investigate Evorto’s add-on webhook replay concern tracked in https\://linear.app/evorto/issue/EVO-61, originally raised on https\://github.com/evorto-app/app/pull/208.\
\
First read the issue, relevant review, current code, and applicable repository instructions. Establish whether subsequent changes have already resolved the concern.\
\
Investigate the crash window where the business transaction commits but the webhook receipt is not finalized. Trace recovered delivery through payment binding, receipt ownership/fencing, and already_applied handling. Include asynchronous payment failure and add-on expiry paths. Determine whether valid replays can incorrectly return state-conflict/409, or cause duplicate effects.\
\
Start with read-only diagnosis against current main. Use disposable database/provider fixtures for reproduction. Preserve tenant/account binding, payment authority, and receipt fencing. Keep live data untouched.\
\
If confirmed, implement a focused fix in a suitable isolated worktree and add behavior tests covering the crash window, successful idempotent replay, and absence of duplicated financial/add-on effects. If ruled out, provide evidence and regression coverage where useful. Run the relevant checks; prepare the result for review without merging or deploying.\
\
Coordinate everything through this main chat. Check current usage before starting; if Astra is unavailable, report that rather than silently substituting another model.\
\
Update ASTRA-002 in /Users/hedde/Documents/Codex/2026-11-04/my/outputs/astra-backlog.md with status and, when finished, findings, validation, and references. Preserve other entries.

I’ll check current usage and Astra availability first, then use Astra for the investigation. I’ll coordinate it here, keep live data untouched, and prepare any confirmed fix for review without merging or deploying.

# Astra backlog

Shared across local Codex projects. Review Fridays at **12:00 Europe/Berlin** and choose valuable work if spare usage is available.

This is a queue, not authorization to start work. The user works through the main chat. Do not postpone urgent work to fill this queue, and verify the actual usage/reset before planning a session around it.

## Ready

No concrete tasks have been nominated yet. Add evidence-backed tasks as they arise in project chats.

## Candidates

Useful categories include architecture decisions, difficult bugs, security and tenant-isolation reviews, and thorough release audits. These categories are not assigned tasks; each needs a specific scope and completion criteria.

### ASTRA-001 — Audit Playwright cancellation during global setup

- **Status:** candidate; observed failure, root cause not yet established
- **Priority / added:** medium / 2026-11-06
- **Project / path:** Evorto, `/Users/hedde/.codex/worktrees/evorto-main-transfer/ci-bootstrap-shipping-clone`; `playwright.config.ts`, `helpers/testing/docker-webserver.sh`, and the environment/process supervisors
- **Source:** walkthrough-to-main transfer, coordinating chat `01a1b0e8-47bf-7651-90e6-491fc828c0c1`; evidence in `/Users/hedde/.codex/artifacts/evorto-wrap-up-2026-11-06/interrupted-e2e-global-setup.log` and `interrupted-e2e-explicit-cleanup.log`
- **Problem / evidence:** Sending SIGTERM to the owned Playwright process during global database setup left its disposable Compose stack and webserver launcher running. Explicitly terminating that launcher still left containers requiring project-scoped cleanup. An immediate restart of the preserved walkthrough app then collided on port 4200; Docker lost that container's network attachment until it was reconnected. The original database/storage were preserved and the app was restored. Normal suite shutdown subsequently cleaned the disposable stack successfully.
- **Why Astra:** Trace signal propagation and ownership across Playwright, Bun's invocation wrapper, shell traps, cancellation channels, and Docker. A careful state-machine review can distinguish a genuine cleanup defect from unsupported interruption mechanics without weakening the existing fail-closed teardown guarantees.
- **Scope / dependencies:** Read-only diagnosis first; use fresh disposable projects and ports. Do not reset or claim an existing developer stack, alter deployment behavior, or switch models automatically.
- **Done when:** Reproduce cancellation during global setup; identify the responsible lifecycle boundary; implement only a justified repair with behavior tests proving bounded cleanup, lease release, and successful reuse of the released port while a separate persistent stack remains untouched.
- **Result:** pending review; immediate cleanup and walkthrough restoration already completed.

### ASTRA-002 — Audit add-on webhook replay after the business commit

- **Status:** candidate; reviewer concern, not independently reproduced
- **Priority / added:** medium / 2026-11-09
- **Project / path:** Evorto, `/Users/hedde/.codex/worktrees/594b/evorto`; Stripe webhook handler and paid add-on checkout services
- **Source:** PR consolidation chat; Franz's review on https://github.com/evorto-app/app/pull/208 ; canonical follow-up https://linear.app/evorto/issue/EVO-61
- **Problem / evidence:** The reviewer reports a possible crash window where add-on changes are committed but the receipt is not finalized. A recovered webhook may then return binding state-conflict/409 despite the business operation supporting already_applied. Similar questions concern async payment failure and add-on expiry. Treat this as a candidate until source tracing and a controlled reproduction confirm it. Receipt ownership fencing and lost-claim logging remain immediate PR208 scope; they are not deferred.
- **Why Astra:** Trace payment binding, transaction boundaries, durable receipt recovery and provider retry semantics across several event types; distinguish a legitimate mismatch from an idempotent replay without opening a cross-tenant or double-application path.
- **Scope / dependencies:** Read-only diagnosis first against current main, then disposable PostgreSQL/Stripe fixtures. Preserve tenant/account binding, refund/charge authority and existing claim fencing. No live data changes, release, automatic execution or model switch.
- **Done when:** Reproduce or rule out each replay path after an already-committed business transaction; record the intended outcomes and evidence in EVO-61. If confirmed, define and implement a separately reviewed fix with tests proving successful idempotent replay and zero duplicated financial/add-on effects.
- **Result:** pending user selection and verification.

## Entry format

- **ID / title:** ASTRA-001 — actionable task title
- **Status:** candidate / ready / in progress / blocked / done
- **Priority / added:** high, medium, or low / date
- **Project / path:** repository or relevant files

- **Problem / evidence:** what needs attention and what is already known
- **Why Astra:** reasoning difficulty or value beyond routine work
- **Scope / dependencies:** boundaries and prerequisites
- **Done when:** observable completion criteria
- **Result:** completed date, findings, and artifact/PR references
